title: Tetris Blast Boom
description: Drag vibrant polyomino pieces onto a clean 8x8 grid to blast full rows and columns in dazzling chain combos—no timer stress, pure brainy flow.
controls: Drag each block shape onto the board to complete full horizontal or vertical lines and trigger combo blasts.

zh-CN.title: 俄罗斯方块大爆炸
zh-CN.description: 抖音超火拖拽方块消除俄罗斯方块大爆炸：自由摆放彩色积木填满整行或整列瞬间引爆清屏，连消爽到停不下来！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动下方彩色方块放入棋盘空位，填满任意一整行或一整列即可触发爆炸消除。
